personajes.en: Afro-Colombian woman, dark brown skin, black braids with white beads, bright yellow blouse, patterned cotton skirt, rubber sandals, wide-brim straw hat, balancing a round aluminum basin of mangoes and pineapples on her head.

Mestizo man, medium brown skin, short black curly hair, thin mustache, green polo shirt, jeans, worn sneakers, cellphone earpiece, holding a motorcycle helmet with a reflective vest draped over his arm.

Afro-Colombian elderly man, gray skin tone, white hair and mustache, reading glasses, light guayabera shirt with open collar, beige linen trousers, leather sandals, plastic stadium seat and folded newspaper under his arm.

Young mestiza woman, olive skin, long dark hair in a high ponytail, denim overalls over a white t-shirt, white sneakers, wireless earbuds, backpack over one shoulder, smartphone in hand, small crossbody pouch.

Afro-Colombian man, deep brown skin, buzz-cut black hair, sweat-soaked orange safety vest over a gray t-shirt, knee-length khaki shorts, rubber boots, hard hat under arm, coiled measuring tape and trowel in hand.

Wayuu woman, brown skin, straight black hair pulled back in a bun, neat white blouse, navy pencil skirt, low black heels, small woven Wayuu mochila bag on shoulder, holding a tablet and a lanyard badge.

Mestizo man, weathered tan skin, silver hair under a faded cap, stubble beard, sleeveless white shirt, rolled blue work trousers, flip-flops, holding a tangled fishing net over one shoulder and a small red cooler.

Afro-Colombian woman, dark brown skin, salt-and-pepper hair in a low bun, floral house dress with short sleeves, flat foam sandals, thin gold chain, carrying a mesh shopping bag with plantains and a small church pamphlet.
